summary: Iteration 22: End-to-end verification of the new Anime vertical. Backend 11/11 pytest passed — anime-series CRUD (list active-only, admin list-all with episode_count, get by id/slug with episodes ordered by anime_series_position, auto-slug + unique-slug guard, PATCH, DELETE unassigns videos), videos filter (is_anime=true only, default hides anime from latest/popular/random, is_anime=false regression), PATCH /api/videos accepts is_anime + anime_series_id + anime_series_position. Frontend: sidebar nav-anime, /anime page (empty state text confirmed), /anime/series/:slug with back link 'Înapoi la Anime', Admin tab-anime-series with new-anime-name / new-anime-btn / anime-row-{id}, Home vertical tab home-vertical-anime + section-anime + section-anime-series all render, EditVideo edit-anime-block / edit-is-anime / edit-anime-series (revealed on toggle) all present, Upload upload-is-anime-block + upload-is-anime switch present in code and correctly gated on !is_short (block/switch only render inside per-file metadata AFTER a file is picked — expected UX consistent with existing shorts-category block).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5016 lines (up from 4874) — well past the 700-line threshold. Anime endpoints (~90 lines) are cleanly localised but continue to grow the monolith. Consider splitting into routers (anime_series.py, shorts_series.py, videos.py, admin.py) in a follow-up refactor.

GET /api/anime-series/{key} returns the series doc FLAT with episodes[] inside (mirrors shorts-series shape). Consistent with front-end usage in AnimeSeriesDetail.jsx — no change needed, just documented for future consumers.
AnimeSeries model lacks the 'display_style' / 'genre' fields that shorts_series has; not a bug, but consider aligning schemas if the front-end grows filters.
seed_data_creation: During tests: created TEST_ActiveSeries + TEST_InactiveSeries + 5 TEST_ videos in Mongo via pytest fixtures (all cleaned in teardown). During Playwright run: created 1 anime series (TEST_UISeed_*) + PATCHed 1 existing video to is_anime=true; both reverted / deleted at end of run via API. Final Mongo state: no lingering TEST_ anime data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Anime vertical fully green. Backend router lives in server.py lines 1027-1145. Frontend tests focus on data-testids: nav-anime, home-vertical-anime, section-anime, section-anime-series, tab-anime-series, new-anime-name, new-anime-btn, anime-row-{id}, upload-is-anime-block, upload-is-anime, edit-anime-block, edit-is-anime, edit-anime-series, anime-series-title, anime-series-back-link. Upload's upload-is-anime-block renders only INSIDE per-file metadata (visible after picking a file) — same pattern as upload-shorts-category-block. EditVideo route is /edit-video/:id (not /edit/:id).

frontend_playwright.home_section-anime: PRESENT when >=1 anime video exists (Section returns null when empty, same behaviour as drama)
frontend_playwright.anime_page_empty_state: 'Nu există încă serii Anime...' text confirmed on /anime when no series
frontend_playwright.anime_series_detail: title + back-link 'Înapoi la Anime' render for /anime/series/:slug
frontend_playwright.admin_tab-anime-series: PRESENT, opens AnimeSeriesTab with new-anime-name + new-anime-btn + anime-row-{id}
frontend_playwright.editvideo_/edit-video/:id: edit-anime-block PRESENT, edit-is-anime toggle PRESENT, edit-anime-series select revealed after toggle=on
frontend_playwright.upload_is_anime_gating: Block/switch defined in code inside per-file metadata; gated by !shared.is_short (line 307 Upload.jsx). Not visible before file selection — matches existing shorts-category block UX.
